domain: Each argument decoded validUTF8 Text0..1024bytes; no trimming/repair. Invalidstrings compare below valid and equal each other, matching pinnedGo semantics.
helpers: Internal bounded parser/record activities are not additional upstream APIs.
native_evidence: examples/version-eligibility/verify.py builds the independent original Go oracle and checks finite Gooo execution plus saved replay. Completed public runs retain separate gooo-semver-example-evidence CI artifacts.

prerelease_identifier_loop.reason: Compare validates before Parts; a prerelease with n nonempty ASCII identifiers needs at least 2*n bytes including its leading hyphen and separators. Text <=1024 bytes therefore permits at most 512; a valid full version also needs the 6-byte minimum core v0.0.0. Build metadata only consumes more bytes.
prerelease_identifier_loop.scope: Public IsValid/Compare/Major/Prerelease and consumers calling them. This is not validation of arbitrary direct malformed helper arguments.
